info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API facilitates the execution and management of internal network operational actions within the IT management framework of a banking system. This endpoint allows authorized users to initiate various operational tasks designed to optimize network performance and reliability. Typical consumers of this API include internal IT teams and network administrators who require automated tools to streamline operational processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure their network operations are efficient and aligned with overall business objectives.

post.summary: Create an operational action for internal network management.
post.description: This operation allows users to create and initiate an operational action related to the internal network management. It is designed for IT professionals who manage network operations and need to execute specific actions effectively.
